_doc: Named thresholds of draft Table V. Frozen with the protocol (E6). sync_threshold is calibrated on references and FIXED_BACKOFF mutants before the freeze (E3).
_doc_late_syn_tolerance_s: Connection attempts seen only in the packet capture (S1, S2, S9) are timestamped with CLOCK_REALTIME and converted to CLOCK_MONOTONIC; the conversion error is below 0.5 ms (E3). Such an attempt counts as late only if it is more than this tolerance after the return.
